summary: Bounded investigation of candidate ARIST-MET-993B-PRINCIPLES-UNCAUSED-IN-BEING. Reused the attribution uniqueness, restricted causal comparative, order-not-first-being and first-mover-first-being types and maximal cause-exclusion type; no new maximality countermodel or vocabulary. Materialized/read ARIST-MET-II-1 (993b24–31) and newly pinned AQUINAS-IN-METAPH-II-L2 in full. In Metaph II lect2 n7 [81861] makes the principles’ uncausedness a reason for maximal truth rather than deriving uncausedness from qualified synonymy. N8 [81862] supplies participation/essence reasoning for separated substance as cause of corporeal substance, without establishing the separated principle’s lack of cause or identity with the unique primary analogate. N6 [81860] invokes common name/ratio of truth, not an unrestricted cause-more-being rule. N11 [81865] announces a following regress argument rather than delivering it in this passage. Exact findings and rejected readings are preserved in docs/being-not-a-genus.md, Uncaused principles. No claim, proof, premise substitution or philosophical discharge is added; root-premise delta 0.
blocker: Need independently defended applicability of the uncaused-principles clause to the same primary analogate selected by attribution, without presupposing its firstness/uncausedness. Simple-priority-to-cause-of-being also remains open. Plural principles of heavenly bodies alone do not establish uniqueness, an uncaused maximum or a unique first being.
